Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns.
Normal returns require items to be in their original, undamaged condition with a receipt within 14 days, and customers are typically responsible for return shipping and a 10% restocking fee.
For a damaged item, you don't need to go through the standard return process—our support team will assist you directly with a resolution. Is there anything else I can help you with?
